title: Anvil Browser
subtitle: Fast, customizable Chromium browser
description:
Anvil is a free desktop web browser built on Chromium for people who want a browser they can shape: a vertical tab sidebar with tab groups, side-by-side split view, Chrome and Firefox extension support, plugins, and eight themes.

It also ships a built-in ad and tracker blocker, an encrypted password manager, opt-in local read aloud, and end-to-end encrypted sync on your own storage.

Available now as an early-access download for Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon), and Linux.
